name: Scattered-Cards Magazine Site
description: An editable, multi-page editorial site with a lively card-led homepage, browsable topics, and distraction-free articles.
whatYouGet: Responsive homepage with a distinctive offset-story layout
Linked topic, archive, article, and about pages
Reusable story cards and article typography
Newsletter section with a configurable destination
goodFit: Independent publishers building a recognizable editorial home
Founders publishing substantial stories around their work
Small teams organizing articles by topic
notFor: A one-page promotion with no ongoing publishing plan
A product catalog or checkout experience

faq.a: Yes. Story cards and article layouts are reusable, so new pieces can follow the same structure and visual rules.

faq.q: Does it need a content management system?
faq.a: No. The initial deliverable works as editable static pages; its structure can be ported to a content system later.

demoPrompt: /sl-scattered-cards-magazine-site Build The Side Margin, an independent journal for people doing creative work. In order, show an intro, latest stories, a shared-studio feature, three topic threads, archive picks, a monthly newsletter, journal FAQs, and reading/contact links. Open with “The Side Margin” and end with “Subscribe.” Use a stacked, cool-paper layout with restrained offset cards and readable type.
followUpPrompts: Add a new topic for independent workshops and two linked articles.
Make the article template support pull quotes and photo captions.
Replace the newsletter placeholder with my signup endpoint.
externalCostNote: No external services. Runs entirely on your agent.
